text: The bug is in `tenacity/wait.py`, `wait_chain.__call__`. It converts the retry attempt to a zero-based index and directly indexes `self.strategies`, so attempts beyond the number of strategies raise `IndexError`. The constructor already correctly rejects an empty chain. I intend to clamp the selected strategy index to the final strategy—e.g. use `min(wait_func_no, len(self.strategies))` before subtracting one—so the last strategy is reused for all later attempts.
